text_block_list.text:
Early one morning, Silence Suzuka was
hard at work training.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—PHEW~! Running alongside you
was SO MUCH FUN, Suzuka!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... No, um, Taiki.
Was that supposed to be tandem running just now...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I was just running by myself.
And then you suddenly jumped in...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, you're pretty much always like this, Taiki...
Whenever I'm running, you immediately dive into my scenery—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
YES! Running with you is
VERY, VERY FUN, Suzuka! So, I just CAN'T HELP IT!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, c'mon, ONE MORE LAP!
LET'S GOOOO☆

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, !?
...Geez, really, Taiki—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (...Come to think of it, the two of us... are always like this.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: At the academy—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Even when we bump into each other off-duty—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...And the same goes for races.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka & Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
YAAAAAAAAAAAA!!
TAAAAAAAAAAAAA!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Before I know it, she leaps into my view.
Into my scenery, which belongs only to me, she—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I thought I didn't really like it... when my solitary view was disrupted—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Where should I make my move next?
Where will Taiki position herself?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I've started thinking about nothing but that...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
HEYYY?! You're taking so long!
...Suzuka? WHAT'S WRONG?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah... no, it's nothing.
............Phew.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I've only just started running, but...
my body feels so warm.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It never turns out like this when I'm alone.
Honestly... it's all your fault, you know?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ! Suzuka—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...YAAAAAAAAAY!!

text_block_list.name: Someone's Scream
text_block_list.text: KYAAAAAAH?!

Early in the morning, someone's scream rang out!
Hurrying toward the sound—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Taiki, sudden hugs startle me, so stop doing that...
Besides, you're gripping too tightly... as always...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, SORRY~! But—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka was all warmed up, and that made ME all warmed up TOO!
I just couldn't hold back!
choice_data_list: You two sure get along well.
You two sure get along well, huh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ! YES! Suzuka and I are BEST BUDDIEEEEES!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Honestly...
Look, you want to run, right? Let's get going soon.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...
Is that... really how it is?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: WHAT?! We're NOT?! NOOOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Eh, I-I'm sorry?!
I mean, we are! ...
